title: The EU is facing Big Tech pressure to revamp its AI law
notes: Politico Europe returned HTTP 403 and no other outlet carries the story. Related context only, not used as facts for this entry: RTE reports that Microsoft president Brad Smith told the Dublin AI summit on 14 Oct that new AI safety laws are urgently needed, and Google DeepMind's Demis Hassabis called for proportionate certification, so the direction of the pressure on the AI Act is unclear.
